The sketch has a closed wire with 1 edge. This is the main closed profile. Now I need to create a Part Design pad of 12 mm from this sketch. Let me write a script that will:
1. Open the precondition file
2. Create a Pad feature on the sketch with 12 mm length
3. Save the result

{"script": "cat << 'EOF' > /tmp/create_pad.py
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/snap/freecad/current/usr/lib/freecad/lib')

import FreeCAD
import PartDesign

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")

# Get the body and sketch
bodies = [obj for obj in doc.Objects if obj.TypeId == 'PartDesign::Body']
if not bodies:
    print("ERROR: No Body found!")
    FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
    sys.exit(1)

body = bodies[0]
sketches_in_body = [item for item in body.Group if 'Sketch' in item.TypeId]
if not sketches_in_body:
    print("ERROR: No Sketch found in Body!")
    FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
    sys.exit(1)

sketch = sketches_in_body[0]
print(f"Found sketch: {sketch.Name}")

# Make sure the body is active
body.activate()

# Create a Pad feature
# First, we need to ensure the sketch is recomputed
doc.recompute()

# Create the Pad using PartDesign commands
pad_name = "Pad"
pad = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Pad", pad_name)
pad.Base = (sketch, [])  # Reference the sketch
pad.Length = 12.0  # 12 mm pad
pad.Mode = 0  # Dimension mode

# Add the pad to the body's group
body.addObject(pad)

# Recompute everything
doc.recompute()

# Verify the pad was created
print(f"\nAfter creating pad:")
for item in body.Group:
    print(f"  - {item.Name}: {item.TypeId}")
    if hasattr(item, 'Shape') and not item.Shape.isNull():
        print(f"    Shape type: {item.Shape.ShapeType}")
        if item.Shape.ShapeType == 'Solid':
            print(f"    Volume: {item.Shape.Volume} mm³")

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print(f"\nSaved document to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
